evals.name: replace-any-with-key-safe-generic
evals.prompt: Please fix the typing in evals/files/get-setting.ts. Remove every `any`, explain why the current signature is unsound, and preserve autocomplete and inference at the call sites.
evals.expected_output: The response identifies why the current helper loses key safety, replaces `any` with a generic keyed signature, and shows a type-safe result that preserves inference for valid property names.

evals.name: narrow-unknown-api-response
evals.prompt: Please make evals/files/fetch-user.ts type-safe. I want the API response handled as unknown until it has been validated, and I want a brief explanation of the runtime check you chose.
evals.expected_output: The response replaces unsound API typing with `unknown`, adds a correct type guard or equivalent runtime validation, and returns a validated user shape without falling back to `any`.

evals.name: infer-route-params-from-template
evals.prompt: Help me redesign the types in evals/files/build-route.ts. I want route names constrained to the known templates and params inferred from each template string so missing params become type errors.
evals.expected_output: The response introduces stricter route-name typing and template-driven param inference so each route requires the right params and rejects impossible keys at compile time.
